answer: Producing a novel, coherent answer each epoch is cheap per alias but prohibitive across thousands, so scale buys less credibility — the attacker cannot simply buy a large, credible flock. This design turns the attacker's greatest weapon — scale — into its weakest point, because scale is exactly what becomes unaffordable to maintain.. This is durable because the trusted grader set only grows through bootstrap capacity, preventing a sudden takeover by a large new flock. Consider a raven as the anchor of the cost.
